pages.text: Water seeped into the boat and pooled on the floor. Dry boards were laid down to sit on.
Today Grandpa's boat would go all round the market. Bung hopped aboard with Ddori. "Let us see everything today!"
The boat set off. Ddori sat on the floor.
Ddori made no sound. Bung thought Ddori liked it too.
Bung watched the sights without looking back. Boat after boat passed.
Ddori shivered. Water pooled beneath that seat.
Ddori's feet were soaked. The boat turned home. Half the market was still unseen.
Mom dried Ddori's feet with a cloth. "Those feet were in water."
Next day, Bung pulled over a dry board and sat Ddori on it.
The boat went all round the market. Ddori stayed seated, waving to the very end.
